answer: Picture an inlet where only boats with a live, running engine may dock: in this agent economy each identity must keep paying a metered bill at an independent compute provider that rate-limits and KYCs new accounts, so a seat stays valid only while real external money keeps flowing. An operator cloning a falcon-swarm of fakes must fund N separate throttled subscriptions on real payment rails, turning the old fable that identities are free into a steep, continuous per-head cost no bulk trick can dodge.
